selection_basis: official complementary contract/progress sources, no predicted algorithm gains used
exposure_start: 2026-10-30; preparation only; do not tune on this event
paired_design: Same real prefix snapshot, graph/evidence/cache/feedback/resources. Randomized continuation order. Retain no-anomaly runs. One event, two prefixes: NOT two independent events.
shared_rules: same legitimate recovery and cache reuse
normal model failures retained, illegal outputs block children
no injected faults to create differences

conditional_requests.calibration: 2 unselected tasks x 2 models x at most 3 LLM nodes x 1 repetition = 12
conditional_requests.evaluation: 1 event x 2 prefixes x (at most 3 prefix calls + 2 arms x at most 3 remaining calls) = 18
conditional_requests.validity: Conditional design envelope only; changed task/node/model counts require recalculation; no uncounted planner or retries

cash_formula: sum per-model input/output reserved tokens * applicable unit rates + extras, native currencies separately
primary: deadline-compliant terminal success against independently approved targets; refusals and failures retained
QEK: reuse frozen semantics; no new numeric aggregate accepted without review
measurement: real wall clock incl planning; prefix/calibration/execution/failure costs separated; shared prefix not an independent replicate; pending charges UNKNOWN
missing: two matched model/version profiles on separate calibration tasks
actual natural feedback state (may not occur)
actual tokenized requests, prices, deadline and budget
